name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: While priests often find their calling in sacred sanctuaries and chapels, life on the road demands practical survival skills beyond prayers and blessings.

faq.answer: Eric is an experienced outdoorsman and fellow adventurer who offers to teach fledgling travelers the essentials of surviving in the wilderness. He welcomes travelers to rest by his campfire and shares practical advice on thriving far from city walls.

Resting beside Eric's campfire provides the Boosted Rest effect, helping weary travelers recover and prepare their spirits for the trials ahead. It represents taking time out of the elements to recuperate properly in the field.
faq.q: What is the Boosted Rest buff?

faq.answer: Camp fixtures are practical structures or tools tailored to specific trade skills that adventurers can set up in the wild. As tradeskill trainers in nearby settlements explain, learning a profession allows craftspeople to establish working setups at their campsites.

Taking a seat beside the campfire allows adventurers to pause, warm up, and listen to Eric's guidance on wilderness survival. It gives the body time to relax and gain the full benefit of restful shelter outdoors.
faq.q: Why do you need to sit near Eric's campfire?

faq.answer: After mastering the basics of resting at camp, Eric suggests heading to the nearby village to study a tradeskill under local craft trainers. Once trained, you can begin learning how to construct camp fixtures suited to your craft.
faq.q: Where should an adventurer go after completing this lesson?

faq.answer: Eric calls out to passing adventurers, noting their restless spirit and readiness to seek fortune and glory across the world. His wilderness guidance helps anyone stepping away from safety and venturing out into the open wilds.
faq.q: Who is this survival lesson intended for?

sections.body: Stepping out into the wider world requires more than ambition and a weapon or holy symbol. For fledgling travelers, survival depends on knowing how to rest properly amidst the elements. At his basic campfire, the seasoned traveler Eric welcomes wandering adventurers to take a seat, warm themselves by the embers, and discover how vital proper rest is before tackling the untamed wilderness.
sections.title: Lessons of the Wild

sections.body: A simple fire is only the beginning of maintaining an effective campsite on long journeys. Upon learning the fundamentals of wilderness recovery, travelers are encouraged to visit tradeskill trainers in neighboring settlements. There, artisans and crafters teach how to assemble specialized camp fixtures, allowing adventurers to practice their professions and support their expeditions wherever the road leads.
sections.title: From Campfire to Craft

summary: The Great Outdoors introduces wandering adventurers to the essentials of wilderness survival and campcraft. By taking a seat at Eric's campfire, travelers learn how to recuperate properly in the wild before taking up tradeskills to support their journeys.
